translations.text: अयं मार्गः पिहितः, अन्यं मार्गं गच्छ।

data.text: The other students are on the playground.
I do my homework by myself.
The baby now eats by itself.
The door opened by itself.
Friends help each other.
The boys argue with each other.
At the festival people give each other sweets.
Well done, you answered correctly.
Bravo, an excellent song!
Your idea is good.
Enough playing; study now.
Enough food, my stomach is full.
Enough arguing; be friends.
